newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Dec 14.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Dec 14.

text.p: Australia's sugar cane crush totalled 372,308 tonnes in the week ended December 14, bringing the crush so far this year to 39.354 million tonnes, grower organisation CANEGROWERS said.

This is ahead of the 37.136 million tonnes crushed at the same time last year. CANEGROWERS reported for crushing week 28 of the 1996 season that average commercial cane sugar (ccs) content was 11.92 percent for the week.
Australian sugar cane crush by region for the week ended December 14 as reported by CANEGROWERS in tonnes. The 1995 crush started on June 13 and ended by December 30.
CCS = Commercial Cane Sugar (sugar content percent)-
